'''Gorensla''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidic]] clan that operated heavily within the [[Black market/Legends|black market]]. Being galactic [[black marketeer]]s, the Gorensla would often operate secretly within the shadows; they would rig laws, control entire [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]], and their organizations would become the front of entire economies. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they played both sides of the war, often selling to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The Gorenslas were also able to trace their lineage back to the ancient Hutt [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Varl/Legends|Varl]], from the [[Old Republic era]]; as, they were recognized as one of the [[Clans of the Ancients]].

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Gorensla [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] was first mentioned, introduced, and identified in the source book, ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', along with the [[Qunaalac]] clan.
